evaluation_title: PromptShield Intent and Privacy Evaluation Dataset
limitations_note: PromptShield achieves high precision on deterministic prompt injection indicators, delimiter breakouts, known jailbreaks, and base64 obfuscation. It demonstrates 100% specificity (0 false positives) across all benign, authorized, defensive, redaction, and educational scenarios. However, as a pure rule-based scanner targeting injection syntax, it does not perform semantic authorization or intent classification on conversational privacy requests (which must be governed by backend access controls). Defense-in-depth (firewall rules + backend RBAC + semantic LLM policy checks) is recommended.
